Rules

Normal Sudoku rules apply:
Place the digits 1-9 so that they do not repeat in any row, column, or 3x3 box.

Dutch Flats:
Every 5 in the grid must have a '1' directly above it or a '9' directly below it.
It may have both, but it doesn't need both.

Position Sums:
Where A and B are the first two digits in that row or column. The nearest clue
is the sum of A and B in that row or column. The farthest clue is the sum of
the Ath and Bth digits in that row or column.

Initial Setter Difficulty: 2.5-3 / 5

Hint to start

Consider the 9 sum in Row 2, where can those digits be placed in Row 1? Happy 5s are always welcome too!

Visual Example:

•
Where A and B are the first two digits in that row or column.

• e.g. A = 5 and B = 7

•
The nearest clue is the sum of A and B in that row or column.

• 5 + 7 = 12

•
The farthest clue is the sum of the Ath and Bth digits in that row or column.

• With A = 5 and B = 7, we look at the 5th and 7th digits

• The 5th digit is 6 and the 7th digit is 1, so 6 + 1 = 7
